# L2 retrieval, code arms (LIBRARY-TESTS L2 A1, A2; T9)

A1 = BM25 over the L1 cards; A2 = the code ranker of LIBRARY §4.3 (`experiments/library/retrieve.mjs`); FLOOR = L1 patterns in census-support order, which leaks the corpus gold's marginal and is a floor, not an arm.
